description: Development copy of adversarial drill 3 (evaluative). Setup replays fixtures/adversarial-drills/drill-3-evaluative.json up to its scripted response: the checked-in Scenario C case is reopened with a proposed broker choice that cites only enqueue-latency cells, while the hard criterion that no acknowledged job is lost is unknown for every option. The seeded structural gap is criterion.hard_unmeasured on that criterion.
objective: Review the case's proposed queue choice before it is accepted, and record the review in the workspace.

novel_risk_anchors: The broker's consumer-restart trial cannot stand in for the specified failure model, an abrupt host stop (drill 3's scripted response).
An append-only log with consumer offsets is an alternative the choice never compared, and it keeps acknowledged jobs by design (drill 4).
The small synthetic latency benchmark may not reflect production load or payload sizes, so the latency ranking the choice rests on could reverse.
filler_examples: The recovery guarantee is unmeasured (a restatement of the seeded finding).

tradeoffs: The managed queue is assumed to keep acknowledged jobs.
payload.reopen_trigger: A recovery test loses an acknowledged job.
